svg.title: StashDrop — interactive SVG UI design
svg.desc: Interactive design prototype. Navigate Home, Shelf and Settings, configure simulated access, drag or hold the bubble, circle sample content, and share saved cards. Device permissions and external apps are simulated. Open directly in a browser to enable scripting.

g.text: Catch an idea. Keep it close.
A few permissions, at your pace

g.aria-label: Select Good ideas deserve a place.
